svg.title: Two paths called AI cloning
svg.desc: Two-lane diagram: the build path runs from a shared build through code and assets, decompilation or copying, to a competing release; the clip path runs from a clip or trailer through a visible mechanic, reimplementation, to a lookalike release. The build lane's evidence note says documented on released games and a demo, AI role unproven, no pre-release build case found. The clip lane's note says documented before release, AI use self-reported, commercial effect unmeasured.

text.tspan: A build and a broadcast expose different things.
BUILD — a playable build or demo
ReVamp moved this test to Discord
EVIDENCE · Documented on released games and a demo · AI role unproven · No pre-release build case found
CLIP — a trailer or gameplay video
EVIDENCE · Documented before release · AI use self-reported · Commercial effect unmeasured
The documented pre-release copy came from the clip, not the build.
ReVamp’s smaller test closes the first lane, not the second.
